Dietary Supervisor

The Riverside Premier Rehabilitation and Healing Center

Pay: $25.00 per hour

Join Our Team!

The Riverside Premier Rehabilitation and Healing Center is seeking an experienced and motivated Dietary Supervisor to join our dedicated team. If you are passionate about providing exceptional dining services and enhancing the resident experience, we would love to hear from you!

Responsibilities:

  • Supervise the daily operations of the Dietary Department.

  • Ensure meals are prepared and served in accordance with residents' dietary needs and physician orders.

  • Oversee dietary staff scheduling, training, and performance.

  • Maintain compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, including food safety and sanitation standards.

  • Monitor food quality, presentation, and resident satisfaction.

  • Assist with inventory management, ordering, and cost control.

  • Collaborate with the Registered Dietitian and interdisciplinary team to ensure high-quality nutritional care.

  • Participate in state surveys and regulatory inspections.

Qualifications:

  • Previous dietary supervisory experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility, Long-Term Care, or healthcare setting preferred.

  • Knowledge of therapeutic diets and food safety regulations.

  • Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.

  • ServSafe certification preferred.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and lead a team effectively.

We Offer:

  • Competitive pay of $25.00 per hour

  • Comprehensive benefits package

  • Paid time off and holiday pay

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement

  • Supportive and team-oriented work environment

Join a team dedicated to providing exceptional care and service to our residents every day.

Apply today and become part of The Riverside Premier Rehabilitation and Healing Center family!

The Riverside Premier Rehabilitation and Healing Center is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Job Title: Area Respiratory Operations Technician
Department: Respiratory Therapy – Multi-site
Reports To: Regional Director of Respiratory Services

Position Overview:
The Area Respiratory Operations Technician supports the Regional Director of Respiratory Services in
overseeing, monitoring, and enhancing respiratory rehabilitation programs across assigned facilities.
This role is responsible for operational, clinical, and educational activities to ensure high-quality
respiratory care and program compliance in multiple skilled nursing facilities.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Program Management:

  • Track respiratory programs daily using multiple EHR and computer systems.
  • Manage scheduling of respiratory therapy treatments, including weekends, and ensure staffing
    coverage.
  • Conduct daily reviews of new patients, including key respiratory indicators, medication use, and
    diagnostic data.
  • Complete order set audits, treatment evaluations, documentation, and care plan compliance
    checks.
  • Maintain accurate patient and facility listings for oxygen and respiratory devices.
  • Perform weekly audits of respiratory equipment, including oxygen concentrators, tanks, Airvo2,
    BiPAP, and CPAP devices.
  • Clinical Support & Communication:
  • Communicate patient respiratory needs, recommendations, and referrals to nursing and therapy
    staff.
  • Follow up on patient care and coordinate with interdisciplinary teams to ensure seamless care.
  • Educate facility staff on proper use, maintenance, and replacement procedures for respiratory
    equipment.
  • Assist with program implementation and updates to ensure consistent clinical standards.
  • Staff Development & Recruitment:
     
  • Conduct onsite and virtual (Zoom) interviews for respiratory staff in assigned facilities.
  • Assist with orientation, onboarding, and ongoing training of new respiratory employees.
  •  Serve as a resource for staff regarding operational systems and clinical processes.
    Equipment & Inventory Management:
  •  Assess and maintain inventory of respiratory equipment and devices.
  • Ensure nonfunctional equipment is removed and communicated during audits.
  • Promote efficient utilization of respiratory equipment to support patient care.
    Quality & Compliance:
  • Support quality improvement initiatives and program evaluation.
  • Ensure documentation, treatment, and equipment management comply with facility and
    regulatory standards.
  •  Provide actionable feedback to the Regional Director regarding program performance and
    operational efficiency.

Qualifications:

  • Strong operational and organizational skills with proficiency in EHR systems and computer
    applications.
  •  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for collaboration with interdisciplinary teams
    and facility staff.
  • Ability to travel regularly to assigned facilities within the region.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail for audits, reporting, and compliance monitoring.

Key Competencies:

  • Operational oversight and program management
  • Clinical decision-making and patient evaluation
  • Staff training, mentoring, and recruitment
  •  Equipment and inventory management
  • Communication and interdisciplinary collaboration
  •  Quality improvement and regulatory compliance

Work Environment:

  • Multi-site travel required.
  •  Combination of onsite facility work, virtual meetings, and administrative tasks.
  • Fast-paced environment requiring adaptability and problem-solving skills.

Registered Dietitian (RD)

 

The Riverside Premier Rehabilitation and Healing Center is looking for a talented and hard-working Full Time Dietitian to join our ever-growing team.

Registered Dietitian (RD) Job Summary:

  • Knowledge of MealTracker and Point ClickCare is a plus.

  • Must be able to type & use computer programs proficiently (i.e., Microsoft Word).

  • Must be able to work independently.

  • Must be able to complete nutrition assessments, provide diet education & attend care plan meetings of assigned residents with clinically complex diagnoses.

  • Must be able to work well with the interdisciplinary team & exhibit strong communication skills.

  • Ensure resident's plan of care is in place and carried out in its entirety.

  • Assist with discharge planning.

  • Precept dietetic interns and instruct them on the competencies required to complete the assigned rotation; providing feedback for incorporation into student evaluations

Registered Dietitian (RD) Requirements

  • Must be a Registered Dietitian

  • Must have a NYS-CDN or receipt of payment

  • Immediate job openings are available.

  • Full time Day shift Only

  • Must be able to work every 5th Saturday or Sunday”.

Pay Rate: Up to Up to $85,000 a year 
(Based on Experience)

Benefits:

  • Highly competitive salary

  • Insurance

  • Fringe Benefits

  • Employee Perks

  • KinderCare Discount

  • Plum Benefits (Discounted tickets to destinations and attractions)

An Equal Opportunity Employer
